17' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

14' 0 - 2 Goal! Leonardo Spinazzola displays great vision and sends a pass to Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
